name: twstock
purpose: TWSE/TPEX 上市清單 + 即時/歷史價格 (LL: 5s/3req limit)
rationale: Officially scrapes TWSE/TPEX; 補 yfinance 對小型 TPEX 股漏抓的場景 (3131,5903,4743 etc).

name: FinMind
purpose: 台股全套 API (free tier, daily limit)
rationale: Open-source TW data; 補 yfinance 拿不到的 2809 (京城銀行) 等冷門金融類.

name: pandas-datareader
purpose: Stooq / 多 source 統一 reader
rationale: Stooq 接口在 yfinance 2025-02 改版後成為 main fallback (deepcharts substack 推薦).

name: yahooquery
purpose: Yahoo Finance 替代庫 (走 v10 quote API,不是 yfinance 的 v7)
rationale: yfinance 2025-02 後常 404, yahooquery 走不同 endpoint, 部分情況可救.

name: yahoofinancials
purpose: Yahoo 另一替代庫, 直接 scrape financialsdata page
rationale: 若 yfinance + yahooquery 都掛, 這個走 page-scrape 路徑.

name: akshare
purpose: 中港台多市場財經 (free, 中國 GitHub 維護)
rationale: 對台股 TWSE 有專屬接口; 跟 yfinance 路徑完全獨立.

name: mplfinance
purpose: OHLCV chart (no data fetch, 後端可視化)
rationale: 純畫圖, 套在拿到資料後做 visual sanity-check.

name: stockstats
purpose: 技術指標 (RSI/MACD/BBands) 從 OHLCV df 計算
rationale: yfinance 拿不到 financials 時, 至少 OHLCV 可算指標當 fallback signal.

name: tls-client
purpose: TLS fingerprint 偽裝 (curl_cffi 補充)
rationale: yfinance Yahoo 2025-02 改版後加 TLS 檢測; curl_cffi 已有, 但 tls-client 是純 Go binding 更輕量.

name: httpx
purpose: modern async HTTP (HTTP/2 native)
rationale: Aegis 已有 httpx_m 但可能沒裝; 對 TWSE/TPEX HTTPS endpoint 比 requests 穩.

name: h2
purpose: HTTP/2 protocol library (httpx 後端)
rationale: TWSE OpenAPI 走 HTTP/2; 若沒裝 httpx 會降回 HTTP/1.1, 慢.

name: brotli
purpose: Brotli compression (Yahoo/TWSE 都用)
rationale: requests/httpx 預設沒 brotli, 對方拒提供壓縮會慢 3x.

name: parsel
purpose: XPath/CSS selectors (Scrapy 抽出來的, lxml 之上)
rationale: MOPS 季報 HTML 結構巢狀深, parsel 比 BS4 簡潔.

name: selectolax
purpose: lexbor-backed HTML parser (10x faster than BS4)
rationale: TWSE/MOPS scrape 量大時 BS4 慢, selectolax C-backed 快.

name: html5lib
purpose: WHATWG-compliant parser (容錯比 lxml 強)
rationale: MOPS 偶有 malformed HTML, html5lib 容錯救命.

name: requests-cache
purpose: HTTP layer cache (sqlite/redis backend)
rationale: Aegis 已有 QuotaSaverCache, 但對 TWSE openapi response 還沒接; 加這個自動快取.

name: diskcache
purpose: pure-python disk cache, SQLite-backed
rationale: 已被 Aegis QuotaSaverCache 用, 但 v139G gap cache 也需要它.

name: tenacity
purpose: retry with exponential backoff + jitter
rationale: 比 ratelimit 細; 對 TWSE 5s/3req 限制要精準 backoff.

name: ratelimit
purpose: function-level call rate limit decorator
rationale: 對 TWSE 的 5s/3req 限制必需 (twstock README 有提到).

name: platformdirs
purpose: cross-platform user cache dir resolver
rationale: gap cache 路徑要在 user appdata 而不是 cwd, platformdirs 統一處理.
